title: Apartment 101, Chapelgate, Drumcondra, Dublin 9, D09H266

seller.name: Karen Reynolds
seller.address: Gillstown, Garlow Cross, Navan, Co. Meath, C15 E8F5

description:
Reynolds & Clare Estate Agents are delighted to present No. 101 Chapelgate to the market — a bright, spacious and exceptionally well-proportioned two-bedroom, two-bathroom first-floor apartment extending to approximately 78 sq.m / 840 sq.ft, ideally positioned within the highly regarded Chapelgate development in the heart of Drumcondra.

No. 101 offers generous and well-balanced accommodation throughout and is presented in excellent condition, having been freshly painted throughout. The accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall, a very large and bright living / dining area with adjoining kitchen, two spacious double bedrooms with fitted wardrobes, including a main bedroom with en suite, and a main bathroom. The apartment further benefits from gas fired central heating, one allocated parking space, and a secure setting within this gated development.

Chapelgate is one of Drumcondra’s most established and sought-after residential developments, tucked away behind the original convent walls on St Alphonsus Road and offering a unique sense of privacy and character in an exceptionally convenient location. All the amenities of Drumcondra are just a short stroll away, including Drumcondra Village, Griffith Park, the National Botanic Gardens, DCU, St Patrick’s Campus and a wide selection of cafés, restaurants, shops and schools. The area is exceptionally well connected, with Drumcondra Rail Station within walking distance, numerous Dublin Bus routes nearby, and easy access to the M1, M50, Dublin Airport and the city centre.

Viewing comes highly recommended.
